scenes.say: Worried about what happens after you buy new glasses? Here is the LenzKare promise.

scenes.en: Peace of mind for your frame.
scenes.say: First, your frame gets a six month warranty.

scenes.en: For the coating on your lenses.
scenes.say: Your lens coating gets a one year warranty.

scenes.en: Changed your mind? Exchange within 7 days. (Exchange only, no money back.)
scenes.say: Changed your mind? You can exchange within seven days. Please note, it is an exchange, not a refund.

scenes.en: One free lens remake after a LenzKare eye test.
scenes.ta: பவர் சரியில்லையா? ஒரு முறை இலவசமாக லென்ஸ் மாற்றித் தருவோம்
scenes.say: And if the power doesn't suit you after a LenzKare eye test, we remake your lenses once, free.

scenes.en: Microfibre cloth. Remove with both hands. Keep in the case.
scenes.ta: மென்மையான துணியால் துடையுங்கள், இரண்டு கைகளால் கழற்றுங்கள்
scenes.say: To make them last, clean with a microfibre cloth, take them off with both hands, and keep them in the case.

scenes.en: On spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses. Free eye test in store.
scenes.ta: ஃப்யூஷன் லென்ஸ் கண்ணாடிக்கு ஒன்று வாங்கினால் ஒன்று இலவசம்
scenes.say: Plus, buy one get one free on spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses. And the eye test in our store is free.
